_comment: Golden LLM response fixture for the news domain. Hand-built against PlanResult, NewsData, SynthesisResult — a valid per-stage output set for a (fictional) news explainer. News has no enrichment mapping, so enrichment_response is null. Drift canary consumed by tests/test_llm_response_fixtures.py.

extraction_response.headline: City closes Harborlink Bridge indefinitely after inspection finds cable corrosion

storyTimeline.label: Routine inspection begins
storyTimeline.description: Contracted engineers start the biennial cable inspection.

storyTimeline.label: Corrosion report filed
storyTimeline.description: Inspection report flags stage-3 corrosion in 12 of 96 suspender cables.

storyTimeline.label: Emergency closure ordered
storyTimeline.description: The transit authority closes the bridge to all traffic overnight.

storyTimeline.label: Repair plan announced
storyTimeline.description: A phased cable-replacement plan is announced with an 18-month estimate.

entities.name: Harborlink Transit Authority
entities.description: Ordered the closure and owns the repair timeline.

entities.name: Mayor Dana Reyes
entities.description: Says her office learned of the report only two days before closure.

entities.name: Castellan Engineering
entities.description: Filed the corrosion report; says it was delivered three weeks earlier.

entities.name: Ferry Riders Coalition
entities.description: Pushing for expanded ferry service during the closure.

claims.claim: 12 of 96 suspender cables show stage-3 corrosion
claims.sourceCitation: Inspection report p.14, obtained by the channel

claims.claim: The mayor's office received the report three weeks before the closure
claims.sourceCitation: Delivery log cited on camera; mayor's office denies receipt

claims.claim: The office learned of the corrosion two days before closing the bridge
Repairs will take 18 months and cost $210 million
The bridge carried about 84,000 vehicles a day before closure

context.value: Adds 35–50 minutes at peak via the Eastgate crossing

synthesis_response.tldr: The Harborlink Bridge closed after inspectors found corrosion in 12 suspender cables; who knew what, and when, is now disputed.
keyTakeaways: Stage-3 corrosion in 12 of 96 cables triggered the closure — verified from the report itself
The engineers and the mayor's office give conflicting report-delivery timelines
Repairs are estimated at 18 months and $210M, with 35–50 minute peak detours
synthesis_response.masterSummary: A sourced explainer of the fictional Harborlink Bridge closure: the inspection that found stage-3 cable corrosion, the overnight emergency closure, the disputed three-week gap between report delivery and action, and the announced 18-month, $210M phased repair — with each claim tracked against its source and verification status.
synthesis_response.seoDescription: Why the Harborlink Bridge closed: the corrosion report, the disputed timeline, and the 18-month repair plan.
